concept: Give a blind agent eyes. Open inside a Claude session that can't see a video, watch one command install the skill, watch a video collapse into a mosaic of extracted frames (near-dupes greyed out), watch the captions/frames/audio pipeline run, then land on Claude answering a question about a specific second from what it actually saw. Close on a bright 'now it watches' button. Violet AI-perception world.
money_shot_note: Scene 5, the grounded answer: the app window reveals Claude answering about 0:30 from a frame it saw, not the title. It's the peak because it's the payoff of the whole premise (an agent seeing), and it lands with a scale-punch on the reserved push cut.
transition_strategy: Hard cuts by default (no dissolves). The single reserved effect (push) fires once, on the cut INTO the money shot. Motion carries through cuts.
music_direction: Electronic, forward, a clean build with a clear button at ~65% for the money beat; cuts snap to onsets.

scenes.intent: Hook on the friction every agent builder feels: a plain agent sees the title, not one frame of the video.
scenes.copy_note: Window titled claude-video. Address types a youtube link and a question; body shows the bare agent conceding it can only see the title.
scenes.sound_cue: low room tone, a single soft key

scenes.intent: Show how little it takes to fix that: one documented command installs the skill everywhere.
scenes.copy_note: Shell prompt types the real npx install line; title reads 'install once, 50+ agents'.

scenes.intent: Make the core idea visible: a video becomes a mosaic of real frames, near-duplicates dropped to save tokens.
scenes.copy_note: 12 tiles assemble as timestamps; a few read 'dup' and grey out (the dedup made visible). Eyebrow: frames, near-dupes dropped.

scenes.intent: Prove the engineering: captions first for free, ffmpeg frames, whisper only when needed.
scenes.copy_note: Three status panes (captions done, frames working, audio idle->done). Eyebrow: captions first, then whisper.

scenes.intent: The payoff: Claude answers about a specific second from a frame it actually saw, not the title.
scenes.copy_note: The window reveals the grounded answer with a scale-punch. Accent-ink lead line lands the moment.
scenes.sound_cue: the button -- one tapestop drop into a bloom

scenes.intent: Land the receipt once: the star count is climbing days after launch.
scenes.copy_note: 5,000 counts up; caption 'stars in days', sub 'and climbing fast'. The only scoreboard beat.
scenes.sound_cue: a rising sub as the number climbs

scenes.intent: Button the thesis and rhyme the open: the blind agent now watches. A bright call to look.
scenes.copy_note: Full violet field, dark ink: 'now it watches'. Caption names the skill. The brightest beat and the loop seam.
